filters.basis: The table holds five galaxies; these are the rows of M51.
Flag 02: determined as a bona fide globular cluster from its U-band photometry (ReadMe note 7). Flag 0 has no U-band photometry, flag 1 is a reddened young cluster and flag 3 has an unreliable U-B.

frame.converter: Each sky position onto the midplane of the inclined disc the image layers are baked on (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

discThickness.basis: The stellar disc's exponential scale height as its scale length over 7.3, the mean flattening Kregel et al. (2002) measured for edge-on discs, with S4G's disc scale length (Salo et al. 2015), 84.2″ = 3.40 kpc: 466 pc. For young objects it is an upper value. Each row's own height is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters of M51 from Lomelí-Núñez et al.'s (2022) Hubble candidates, those the paper's U-band photometry marks as bona fide: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
